notes: A complete redesign built on Material 3 Expressive: every screen rebuilt with rounder shapes and bigger type, five colour themes derived from a single source colour (Settings, Colour), an Expressiveness setting for how far corners round and how much things move, a Following page that now shows offline channels as well as live ones, and bundled typefaces so text looks right on every phone. Ad-free playback, Picture-in-Picture and chat work exactly as before.
